title: Fetch with an Injected Transport
prompt: Implement get_status(base_url, path, transport=None) that composes url = base_url + path, calls transport(url) (default transport raises RuntimeError('no network in sandbox')) expecting an object with attributes .status and .read(), and returns (status, parsed-json-body).

tests.name: uses the injected transport
default transport is explicit about no network
tests.hint: None transport → RuntimeError('no network in sandbox').

tests.name: url composition
